title: Illusory Self
html:
Illusory Self is an Illusion School wizard passive feature and reaction that lets a character substitute a duplicate image of themselves when receiving an attack, causing the attacker to miss.

Description

Interpose an illusory duplicate of yourself between you and an attacker's strike, making them miss their attack.

You must Short Rest to use this feature again.

 Reaction

 Recharge: Short rest
